name: तेज़ टाइपिंग
tagline: अंश को शब्द-दर-शब्द टाइप करें: एक मिनट में कितने शब्द?
description: तेज़ टाइपिंग मुफ़्त खेलें: क्लासिक और मौलिक पाठों पर टाइपिंग टेस्ट, अकेले या दोस्तों के साथ दौड़ में।
about: Speed Typing is a typing test and a race: type a passage exactly, word by word, as fast as you can. Your speed is measured in words per minute, counting a word as five characters with spaces, and your accuracy shows how many of your key presses were right.

The passages come from public-domain classics, such as Jane Austen, Charles Dickens, Lewis Carroll and H. G. Wells, and from short texts written for kefche about everyday things. Choose a short text, a sentence or two, or a whole passage. Speed Typing is played in English and Bulgarian, with Bulgarian classics by Botev, Vazov, Yavorov and Aleko Konstantinov.

Practise alone and beat your best on this device, or race up to seven friends in a private or public room on the same text. Leaderboards keep the best speeds for each language and length. Speeds are measured on each player's own device.
howToPlay: Choose a short text or a long one. The text appears with a box to type in below it.
The clock starts with your first key. Type each word exactly, with its capitals and punctuation, and press Space to go on.
Each letter shows as you type it: right, wrong, or still to come. A wrong word can't be finished until you fix it.
The last word needs no space. Your speed is the whole text's characters over your time, and your accuracy counts every wrong key.
In a race, everyone types the same text, and the fastest speed wins.
controls: Use a real keyboard for your best speed; a phone's keyboard works too.
Backspace takes a letter back. Pasting doesn't work.
Curly quotes and long dashes from a phone keyboard count as the plain ones.
In Bulgarian, a keyboard without Cyrillic types phonetically (A gives А).
tips: Look at the text, not at your hands, and keep your fingers on the middle row.
Accuracy first: fixing a mistake costs more time than typing steadily.
Read a word or two ahead while you type the current one.
Keep a steady rhythm rather than bursts of speed.
Short texts suit warming up; long ones show your real speed.

faq.question: Is Speed Typing free?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: How is my speed counted?
faq.answer: In words per minute: every five characters you typed, spaces included, count as one word, over the time from your first key to the last word.

faq.question: Where do the texts come from?
faq.answer: From public-domain classics, with their author and work shown, and from texts written for kefche.

faq.question: Can I race my friends?
faq.answer: Yes. Make a room, invite up to seven friends, and you all type the same text at the same time.

faq.question: Why are speeds marked as measured on the device?
faq.answer: Each player's own browser times their typing, so a speed depends a little on the device. Speeds no human could type don't count.
